name: ionbase-icons
description: IonBase icon set — 1753 icons, one React component each, tree-shakeable. Derived from Lucide (ISC).
//exports: Per-icon subpaths are the point. `ionbase-icons/icons/copy` pulls one module; the barrel exists for discovery and DX and is safe only because sideEffects is false. See README - a barrel of 1700+ icons defeats tree-shaking in several bundlers, which is why ionbase-ui deliberately ships no icon set of its own.
//devDependencies: React is a peer dependency — consumers bring their own, and nothing here should pin one. It is also a devDependency because a peer is not installed for a workspace package, so without it `tsc` cannot resolve the JSX runtime and the generated icons do not typecheck.
